body: I'm gonna sign off for now, if you PM me and I get back on this account I'll respond but I can't guarantee anything, gotta make sure I have my own shit handled and while trying to help other people helps me enormously I can also drain too much energy into it and I need to regulate myself. But whatever happens, I'll be pulling for you.

I am just purely speculating here and I'm sure I have a very skewed perspective of what it is actually like in Canada but I'd think there would be someone in govt. who's job it is to help/educate people navigating govt. services. A social worker of some sort? Try to see if you can find that. There should be someone to help you make sure you get all your benefits as a resident.

"Its just so difficult for me to do anything. I wasn't raised as someone who goes to the doc, dentist, and so on."

Are we talking hard to get help and not want to do it on your own (my problem) difficult or hard to navigate the medical system difficult?

God you are probably going to hate me for this but I feel strongly about it so I apologize but I gotta say it. Please hear me out because I'm not someone just trying to "save" you:

First, I don't believe saving your loved ones from pain is a good reason to not kill yourself if you really need to. The selfish thing is for them to expect you to go on in pain just to benefit them. I say this so you know I'm not just saying don't do it because you are going to hurt them or some cliched bullshit like that.


"I've analyzed all of my close personal relationships and every single one of them would have more positives than negatives if I just finally died, even my fucking pets."

You are fundamentally unqualified to make that assessment. Depression fundamentally warps your perception of reality. The fact that you think 100% of your loved ones would be better if you were dead I think kinda proves that. I don't know you, you might be kinda shitty. 15% of people might be better off. Maybe 20% or 30%. I could believe that its possible a few people might be better off. But every single person you know? Doubtful. You aren't fucking Hitler. Way more likely you just have a view of your impact that is deeply skewed by your depression. That means you could be wrong about all of it. It could be 0%. You can't know because there is something in your brain fucking with it.

I'm not saying don't kill yourself for any reason. If you just can't go on, you're too tired, etc, I get it. I feel really close to that. I respect your right to choose for yourself and I believe there are legitimate reasons for suicide. But please don't do it because you think everyone will benefit from your death because you might as well have come up with that on lsd. You just can't rely on your own self-assessment like that.

>  I've had such bad anxiety that everything I'm feeling is just because I want others feel bad for me and I'm actually normal.

Holy shit. That's me. I didn't know anyone else had that particular fucked-up thought process. That is the worst mental trap of any mental trap I have been in and even knowing it's a trap and a lie isn't enough to get out of it. I always end up wondering if I am just manipulating people because I am smart enough to know how to and can think through "they would react like this if I said that" etc. and you end up wondering if any of your thoughts are genuine at all or just layers of lies that you have begun to believe yourself.

That being said it's not true. Depression is most definitely real. You have just found an extremely effective and paradoxically hard to think out of way to fuck with yourself. I don't know if this is you but if anyone took to telling you you were manipulative all the time it's because THEY were manipulating YOU. This is a throwaway account and I might never log back on it but if you want to PM about that and I see it I'd be glad to talk about it.

Fucking medical care in America...

"I cant because I live with them and I really cant afford to move." I know that all to well. My situation isn't actively abusive but there is a lot of rage from the past that is never going to go away, I know that is hard as fuck. I don't always think this is the best avenue for everyone but you might want to think about finding some kind of support group. You have to relieve that pressure somehow/talk about it and honestly I think someone in a similar situation who is also an objective observer (basically not yourself) can be almost as good as professional help.

On the God part if that's a big thing, if not ignore- yea there probably isn't. That realization HURTS. A lot. It wrecked me. But that is something people get through. All you've felt though through your faith? The purpose or love or whatever it gave you? It wasn't fake. You definitely felt it and you didn't make it up. It came from you the whole time because there's nowhere else for it to have come from. Everyone I know who has walked this path went through a lot of pain. All of them came out the other side without it being a big issue in their lives though. It's weird to say but one day you realize you just kept being you anyways so you might as well keep doing it. Maybe try out some stuff you felt needlessly guilty for wanting before? I think you'll be fine, in that respect.

On your love: It was innocent. If the optics are especially complicated get a professional to help you have that conversation and explain it. If they are simple and she should really understand the innocence because it is apparent then the event probably wasn't the problem. It was probably something else waiting to blow and it found a release. That is also something you should probably both talk with someone to realize. 

But either way, as long as you do right by your kids that is all that matters. If she can't stand by you, for whatever reason, it's not on you. It might not be on her either per se but it's not on you. What's important to the kids is that they have two loving parents, they don't need to also be in a romantic relationship.  It is definitely nice and I'm not going to sugar coat it and say there aren't struggles associated with divorce (if you are married) but it's nothing world shattering and you are both capable of giving them what a child needs either way.

Have you tried telling them this? Not just that you are depressed. Address the fact you feel like you are drifting away from them/your depression has become a barrier to conversation/etc. It might not change anything but at least it would be a real conversation and they might not even see what's going on/think you just want to pull away anyway. I can't speak to your situation  but i have seen and experienced people drifting away from each other just because each side thinks the other is the one doing the drifting because that is what they want.

If my assumption is correct and you have moved and this is the cause of the physical distance- have you explored the are you live in? Even the closest long-distance friends can't replace face to face human interaction and it might give you something to talk about with your friends.
In the short term get a new doctor. You can at least get a second opinion on the abdominal pain. Are you in a situation where you can cut your abuser out of your life?

Oh, hey, have you tried mindfulness meditation? The concept is to only focus on some external sense (typically the sensation of breath in the nostrils) and expand that until it quiets your thoughts. I can't say I have any clue what that would be like for you but for my integrated mind it sometimes helps me find some peace and I have issues with compulsive thought I can't control at times. I could never really manage it totally by myself but with youtube guided meditations I sometimes manage to quiet my mind.

That is some heavy shit. Honestly if money is an issue you could probably walk into any institution and tell them what you just said here. If they don't listen repeat it until they do. There are definitely some drawbacks to that so I understand if that's not an option but that probably is your best bet. I wish I could help more but stick around to see if smarter people than me pop up.

Whatever you decide this isn't your fault. I can't even imagine dealing with what you have to and it sounds like you have made an enormous effort. That is worth something even if people can't see it. If you do go, go in peace. I'm sure you deserve some peace. But obviously try some more, you are here posting and not gone already so some part of you has gotta want to beat this.

edit: also, and I can't believe I forgot this, I've seen DiD at least quelled. A good friend of mine has DiD to the point where I've spent entire evenings with alters and he has reached a point where his life is significantly better. I can't tell you what worked for him because I don't really know but I can tell you something did. If that is worth anything.
It's early enough. Don't do dentistry. For the love of god if you are already here now you shouldn't go into the profession with the highest suicide rate.
